subject: Problem with hline, getting error: Error: attempt to apply non-function

messages.author: f368c21fda2001f6
messages.subject: Problem with hline, getting error: Error: attempt to apply non-function
parts:
I have a data frame called exp_plot

> str(exp_plot)
'data.frame': 2 obs. of 3 variables:
$ Gene : Factor w/ 17322 levels "A1BG","A1CF",..: 9297 9297
$ variable: Factor w/ 2 levels "PALFYN","PAKZZK": 1 2
$ value : num 10.2 10.2

> exp_plot
Gene variable value
1 MGP PALFYN 10.1539
2 MGP PAKZZK 10.1937

I simply want to plot 2 horizontal lines one for each row at value.

> ggplot(data=exp_plot) + geom_hline(aes(yintercept = value))
Error: attempt to apply non-function

I did it this way because I eventually want to add other layers to
it. I've tried other things like
> ggplot(data=exp_plot) + geom_hline(aes(yintercept = exp_plot$value))
Error: attempt to apply non-function
> ggplot(data=exp_plot) + geom_hline(aes(yintercept = value), data = exp_plot)
Error: attempt to apply non-function
> qplot(value, data = exp_plot, geom = "hline")
Error: attempt to apply non-function

All get the same error. The hline plot works, I've tried it with
simple integer values but for some reason when I try to reference the
exp_plot data frame it messes up. I've tried restarting R and stuff
too. Also, I've tried using other geoms with the data set such as bar
and they work. It's just hline that doesn't work.

Any help is appreciated!

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Problem with hline, getting error: Error: attempt to apply non-function
parts:
Hi:

I think the problem is that you did nothing to set up a plot -
geom_hline() provides a form of annotation. This is roundabout but
seems to work:

ggplot(exp_plot, aes(variable, value)) + geom_point(colour = NA) +
geom_hline(aes(yintercept = value)) + ylim(10.1, 10.2)

All I did was to produce a scatterplot with geom_point(), blanking out
the values, then inserted the two lines with geom_hline().

Dennis
